dict.string: PolyTranslate Live needs the microphone to recognize and translate what you say. 需要麥克風權限才能辨識你說的話並翻譯。
PolyTranslate Live needs speech recognition to turn speech into captions. 需要語音辨識權限才能把語音轉成字幕。
PolyTranslate Live needs Screen & System Audio Recording to caption the audio your Mac plays (meetings, videos). No video is stored. 需要「螢幕與系統音訊錄製」權限才能擷取電腦播放的聲音，不會儲存畫面。
PolyTranslate Live needs system audio access to caption the audio your Mac plays. 需要系統音訊權限才能擷取電腦播放的聲音。
